about_the_game:
This is the corridor of a student dormitory with a hundred-year history… and you find yourself sleeping in it.

You awaken as a cat, your memories lost. Paws in place of hands, fur covering your face — the only thing you remember is that you were once a resident here.

But fortunately, the one you’ve transformed into is ‘Bon’, the dorm cat loved by everyone.

Stroll through the corridors, chat with the dorm residents, receive treats, run errands, and when you’re tired, curl up for a nap under the kotatsu.

Run freely through a realistically recreated 2D map of this historic dorm — as a cat. Talk to the residents, help solve their problems, and pick up useful tidbits of information. Choose your what you say wisely — friendship can bring unexpected rewards...

Every resident has their own personality and routine. Some can only be found at certain times and places. When you’re tired of roaming, curl up and sleep until the right moment comes.

While enjoying this carefree moratorium that only a cat can enjoy, search for the secrets hidden within the dorm and the memories you’ve lost.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave
  • Processor: Intel 64-bit + Apple silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio

Roam a century-old student dorm, chat with residents, nap under the kotatsu, enjoy a cat life while uncovering lost secrets and your past. ※This game is distributed with permission from the Yoshida Dormitory Student Council.
